title: What's new in BrickVerse Creator
subtitle: Create faster with flexible workspaces, expanded scripting, richer world systems, and more reliable play testing.

sections.title: A workspace that works your way
sections.body: Creator's interface is more flexible, discoverable, and comfortable for long building sessions.
items: A new docking system lets panels move between regions, tab together, and restore their layout across sessions
The Command Palette puts common Creator actions, tools, and navigation a quick search away
Find in Files searches across project scripts, while viewport bookmarks make important locations easy to revisit
Scene statistics, contextual tutorials, notifications, loading skeletons, and improved settings controls provide clearer feedback
Ribbon tools, local pivots, gizmos, selection bounds, custom instance icons, and docked editors received broad usability and stability improvements

sections.title: Animation and procedural creation
sections.body: New editors make it easier to author motion, effects, and generated environments inside Creator.
items: The overhauled Animation Editor supports dedicated tracks, keyframes, transform channels, and instance property bindings
PCGSpline adds editable procedural paths with in-viewport controls for building roads, trails, and other spline-driven content
The Particle Editor provides a focused workflow for authoring and previewing particle systems
Terrain tools add generation controls plus dedicated grass and water settings
Project snapshots and improved build feedback help protect work and make longer operations easier to follow

sections.title: Forge, MCP, and visual scripting
sections.body: Assisted and node-based creation workflows now reach more of the project.
items: Forge was redesigned with MCP support, custom MCP servers, project-aware tools, and an integrated shell workflow
Local CEF installation and authentication improvements make Forge setup more dependable across supported platforms
Experimental Visual Scripting adds a graph editor and runtime provider for building behavior without writing source code
Visual Script nodes, connections, execution, serialization, and editor interactions received a follow-up reliability pass
Creator APIs and context services expose more project operations to integrated creation tools

sections.title: More ways to script
sections.body: Projects can experiment with additional languages while Luau becomes faster and more capable.
items: Early C#, C++, JavaScript, and TypeScript providers add language-aware files, compilation, bindings, and capability bridges
Parallel Luau introduces Actor-based isolated execution, synchronization helpers, and a scheduler for parallel-safe work
LocalNetworkEvent replaces BindableEvent for local event-driven communication between scripts
Generated IDE support, definitions, enums, overload resolution, array conversion, and property synchronization are more complete
API documentation is now generated and published automatically from the engine's current scripting surface

sections.title: An expanded DataModel
sections.body: New reusable instances cover gameplay, rendering, navigation, capture, optimization, and world simulation.
items: Pawn, Weapon, Vehicle, VehicleWheel, Buoyancy, DamageVolume, ForceVolume, TriggerVolume, and Countdown provide higher-level gameplay building blocks
LODGroup, VoxelVolume, NavigationObstacle, ReflectionCapture, SceneCapture, and CaptureSurface extend large-world and rendering workflows
CollectionService, DebrisService, ObjectPoolService, RunService, SchedulerService, SoundService, StudioService, and TemporaryFile expand engine services
Explosions gained configurable physics, damage, effects, and lifecycle behavior, while NPC movement, seating, climbing, and rotation became more robust
World, bounds, input, color, UI, camera, tween, physics, environment, tool, stat, and interaction APIs received new capabilities and fixes

sections.title: Node-based audio
sections.body: A new audio graph makes spatial sound routing and processing composable.
items: AudioPlayer, AudioEmitter, AudioListener, and device input and output nodes define sources and destinations
AudioWire connects graph nodes for explicit, reusable signal routing
AudioFader, AudioEqualizer, and AudioReverb add common processing controls
Sound exposes peak volume plus expanded spatial, attenuation, and customizable effect properties
Sound buses now use stable network object identities for more reliable replicated audio

sections.title: Faster, steadier multiplayer worlds
sections.body: Replication and networking work focused on scaling busy experiences without sacrificing consistency.
items: Authoritative spatial streaming sends clients the world state relevant to their current location
Transform snapshots use a more efficient algorithm with chunk throttling and better handling of sleeping or frozen objects
Large network messages are framed and delivered more reliably, with test coverage for packet compression and RPC contracts
Pending parent resolution, dynamic discovery, property and script synchronization, shutdown, and reconnect paths were hardened
Draw-call reductions and targeted performance fixes improve runtime behavior in complex scenes

sections.title: Creator testing and diagnostics
sections.body: New tools help creators reproduce problems and understand projects before publishing.
items: Device input simulation and UI emulator improvements make multiple screen and control configurations easier to test
Prefab and linked-model views clarify reusable content and its source relationships
The engine crash reporter captures failures, while optional console access improves development diagnostics
Client join-state diagnostics and integrity checks provide clearer information when a play session cannot connect
Automated DataModel, authentication, scripting, networking, compression, integrity, and formatting checks strengthen release validation

sections.title: Mobile and cross-platform polish
sections.body: The client experience is more complete and predictable across phones, tablets, macOS, iOS, and Windows.
items: Mobile home, worlds, search, collection, guild, profile, avatar, parental-control, reporting, notification, and transaction views were expanded
Feed creation, comments, friends, place details, purchases, and marketplace browsing received richer mobile components
Camera gestures, touch scrolling, responsive layouts, authentication, in-app purchases, and launch routing were refined
macOS connection and permission handling, iOS arm64 packaging, and Windows export configuration were corrected
A new boot splash, updated typography, and refreshed icons give the client and Creator a more cohesive presentation
